title: Non-invasive ultrasound-based quantification of perfusion parameters, fibrosis, inflammation and steatosis in paediatric patients after liver transplantation
summary: The planned study will test new ultrasound-based (sonographic) methods for transplant monitoring in children who have undergone liver transplantation. Image-based markers will be developed that reliably indicate the condition of the transplanted liver, such as inflammatory reactions. In a first step, the image data will be compared with histopathological data from routine samples (biopsies). The aim is to reduce the number of biopsies needed to monitor the transplant and prevent complications.

interventions.name: Biopsy of the transplant liver and histopathological evaluation of the liver parenchyma (routine)
Sonography of the transplant liver using new sonographic techniques and image-based assessment of the liver parenchyma (study) in the same child.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Status after liver transplantation
- Clinically indicated liver biopsy 
- Referral for ultrasound examination of the liver
- Written informed consent from patient (depending on developmental stage) and legal guardian
Exclusion criteria:
- Non-compliance by the patient
- No written consent from patient / legal guardian
